## How to Use This Document

- One persona per primary or secondary user group. Skip generic ("the user") — every persona must represent a real, distinguishable role with its own goals and constraints.
- Each persona captures: **role and context · goals · pain points · key behaviours · access patterns**.
- Cross-reference Glossary terms; do not redefine.
- Personas ground story-writing in real user contexts. BMad SM workflows consume them as grounding.
